title: Acceptance criteria for textile and expanded vinyl wall or ceiling coverings tested to ASTM E 84 or UL 723.
officialText:
Textile wall and ceiling coverings and expanded vinyl wall and ceiling coverings shall have a Class A flame spread index per
Section 803.1.1.1; shall meet the smoke-developed index requirements of Section 803.1.1.3; and shall be protected by an automatic sprinkler system installed in accordance with Section 903.3.1.1 or 903.3.1.2.
